messages:
nora: onboarding update: bring-up of aurora-ptq surfaced funcall parse regressions in golden streaming tests. overall pass dropped 99.4 -> 93.2 when prefix > 800 tokens.

eli: any failing sample?

nora: captured a minimal repro: model emitted a stray CR (\r) between key and colon which breaks strict-json parsers on the client. only seen on retries + streaming glue.

```
{"tool":"classify","args":{\r"items":[{"id":1,"label":"ok"}]}}
```

cheng: that CR is weird. token traces show aurora-ptq emits 0x0d token unusually when decoding sequences with embedded timestamps. non-quant variants fine.

eli: could be decoder LUT offset or kernel fallback emitting control char as separator.

nora: quick mitigation: enable postproc control-char strip for canaries and add schema-delta alert > 2%.

infra-bot: Canary job queued: cci-88999 for aurora-ptq replay across sharded + non-sharded. link: https://ci.redwood/cci/88999.

cheng: i'll dump decoder mapping and compare compile flags. if it's LUT mismatch i'll patch compile attrs.

eli: i'll add a unit test in tokenizer roundtrip that injects CR and NBSP sequences for quant profiles.

nora: assigning owners: cheng on root cause, eli on tests, i'll own canary + playbook. ETA EOD tomorrow.

cheng: noted. will also check interaction with retry window since retries amplify the probability.

nora: thanks folks — will update when canary finishes.
